cache: Step 1 keeps an auditable diagnostic bank only; production online/cache choice is deferred to Step 4. Any cache must bind frame/source digest, camera, teacher weights, preprocessing, normalization, source/runtime and contract identities.
conditioning: Unchanged Week 5 FutureInputBuilder + frozen base final hidden states from current dual-camera images and instruction, current state, ordered actions and horizon. Teacher tokens are targets only.

diagnostic.limits: Teacher engineering feasibility only, not Week 6 predictor acceptance; no validation/test payload access.
diagnostic.selection: All 40 training tasks sorted by task key; one episode/task with L>=37, minimum SHA256(jepa-target-step1-v1:episode_index); anchors floor((L-33)*n/4), n=1,2,3; all five horizons

encoder.output: pooler_output after the last vision block and pretrained spatial merger, before the language model

preflight_revision.reason: Serialize TorchVersion as a plain string; second attempt stopped before model/data reads. Target definition, selection and thresholds unchanged.

preprocessing.image_temporal_handling: duplicate the same image across the temporal patch; no other frame enters
preprocessing.pixel_resolution_comparison: Pixel image supervision is 128x128 box-reduced; JEPA teacher sees native 256x256 RGB. This resolution difference is explicit, not an isolated loss-function-only comparison.

target.camera_layout: front 64 then wrist 64; each 8x8 row-major after 2x2 spatial merge
target.copy_latent: identical encoder and normalization on current RGB at t; target RGB at t+h
target.normalization: FP32 per-token channel LayerNorm without affine parameters, then per-token unit L2
target.output_projection: Step 3: separate trainable 256-to-2048 projection; no learned target projection
target.zero_centered_token_rejection: LayerNorm output norm <= 1e-6 or any nonfinite token

unfrozen: Step 2 retrieval pools and numerical predictor gates
Step 4 objective weights, optimizer and resource/cache recipe
